systems.system: ANRPTS registration of refugees and asylum-seekers
systems.country_label: registration by the National Civil Registry Agency (ANRPTS); National Identification Numbers (NNI)
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior and ANRPTS, with UNHCR
systems.tiers: registration of refugees and asylum-seekers in urban and rural areas and issue of NNIs; 128,000 registered refugees and asylum-seekers as of 29 February 2024

systems.system: ANRPTS mobile registration in Hodh Chargui
systems.tiers: mobile registration in remote locations (Dwenkara, Adel Bagrou, Bousteilla, Djigueni, Fereini) to address the registration backlog
updated to include new arrivals in the social safety net

note: The registration described is the registration of refugees as persons and the issue of identification numbers, not the registration of births or deaths; the mobile registration is fielded to clear a backlog.
